board.name: Goa Board of Secondary and Higher Secondary Education (GBSHSE)
board.summary: The school examination board for Goa's secondary and higher secondary stages; check gbshse.info directly for its current syllabus, timetables and notices.

intro: There is no NXTutors city tuition-jobs page in Goa yet, so tutors in Panaji, Margao, Vasco da Gama, Mapusa, Ponda and the state's smaller towns join from here. Name your town and the localities you can reach. A request for home lessons goes first to the nearest suitable tutors, then further out, so a precise base helps a family nearby see your profile. Online lessons are matched by subject, class and board instead of location, so a tutor in Bicholim or Quepem can be shortlisted for a student in another state.

Goa students may follow GBSHSE, CBSE, ICSE or another board, so list every board and medium you teach. Read the current syllabus and timetables on the board's own site before a demo. For each request, the family receives two or three tutor profiles with fees shown; the first class is a free demo, you set your own fee, and families who want a change later can switch without paying for it. Name the classes you prefer, from primary to higher secondary, and whether you are free on weekday afternoons, evenings or weekends. Tutors in North Goa and South Goa towns follow the same steps.

faqs: Where can I read GBSHSE details?
On the board's own site, gbshse.info. It did not load when we prepared this page, so we have not summarised it; check it directly before a demo.
Can I teach students outside Goa?
Yes, online. Online lessons are matched by subject, class and board, so students anywhere in India can be offered your profile. Home lessons go to the nearest suitable tutors first.
How does NXTutors pick tutors for a family?
Two or three are shortlisted, nearest first, then wider and online. The family sees each fee, has a free first class, and can move to a different tutor later at no charge.
